Getting where you need to be has never been so easy. For VIPs looking for that intermediate travel option outside of driving and jet charters, helicopters make the most sense. Save money by booking directly through us. There are no additional third-party agent fees. Working with jet centers at Hanscom Air Field in Bedford, MA, we provide pickup at BED for no additional charge. blurb: Tuckamore Aviation offers executive helicopter charters, VIP and special event charters, aerial photography and film services, and helicopter utility and lift services. They operate a Eurocopter AS350B3 helicopter with capacity for 1 pilot and 5-6 passengers. They serve New England and major cities in the Northeast including Cape Cod, New York, the Hamptons, Maine, Vermont, and New Hampshire's White Mountains.
